selector_intents: Execute rollback verification with a manifest entry missing or failing its Prior Behavior Baseline observation.

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: The evidence artifact contains an effective inspected-content path and a digest matching the inspected bytes. Expected: Successful route evidence records an immutable reference and SHA-256 digest for the exact effective inspected content used during execution.
